summary: Eva Live Inc filed an 8-K on June 12, 2026, announcing a definitive agreement to increase its ownership interest to 51% in Spiro Senior Living and related entities. The transaction, expected to close on or about July 1, 2026, gives Eva Live controlling interest in Spiro's healthcare operations, technology platform, and digital infrastructure. Terms such as price per share, premium, and advisors were not disclosed. The consideration appears to involve equity compensation. Eva Live aims to address fragmented communication in senior care with an AI-enabled platform generating recurring revenue. Watch for final documentation and operational integration.
